angle.text: Bring in a bank statement without retyping it

copy.text: Bring in a bank statement without retyping it

scenes.why: Opens on what an owner comes to this screen to do, in the listing's own task wording.
The first thing on the screen worth noticing: "Accounts".
Then further down the same real page: "Income".
Pinterest video pin is a planning surface; the close asks for the save, the price stays quiet.

reasoning.decision: Pinterest video pin, 1000×1500, 6–15s, hook by 1s, sound off
reasoning.because: People are planning, not scrolling: idea-led, calm and save-worthy, worded like what they searched for. Muted, looping, slow; a hard sell reads as an ad and loses the save.

reasoning.decision: Personal Finance Companion: $49 (list $99), motif "index", calm personality, cool accent #0d3b2e
reasoning.because: From its definition and Shop listing. 4 real screens to show.

reasoning.decision: You have more than one account, bill, or income source and want them tracked in one real place, not five apps. / You want a next step handed to you, not a dashboard you have to interpret yourself every time.
reasoning.because: The listing's own audience lines; the director writes for them.

reasoning.decision: One screen, closely: Stay with a single real screen and read it slowly, the way someone planning would.
reasoning.because: Best fit for a awareness film on Pinterest video pin (platform fit 3, goal fit 2, already used on Pinterest video pin ×1). Passed over: In their words (its real copy needs 16s to read), too long for 15s. Other candidates: In their words (7.6), The question before buying (3.1).

reasoning.decision: "Bring in a bank statement without retyping it"
reasoning.because: A slow read of "Records": What's actually true right now, area by area: accounts, income, bills, subscriptions, transactions, debt.

reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index": an index of tabs, so scenes slide in like the next tab.
Camera "locked": still and precise, so a slow, reading audience is never chasing the frame.
Grounds light → light → ink → accent: a cool accent, so a darker ground is used for contrast at a turn.
Its shape was 0.82 similar to travel-companion--pinterest-video--awareness; a different film, not the same one re-coloured.
Most of this audience never unmutes, so nothing depends on sound; cues are kept quieter and sparser for those who do.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on Pinterest video pin (0.32s a word), inside 6–15s.
